subject: Take-home prompt delivery, access TTL & reviewer rotation plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood take-home: systems prompt (access TTL 72h)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the next step. Attached is the take-home prompt (redwood_takehome_spec_v2.pdf). A couple of quick notes on logistics so there’s no ambiguity:

- Access TTL: the prompt Google Drive folder will be available for 72 hours from the time you first open the link (this helps us keep shared materials locked after the exercise window).
- Submission deadline: please upload your final submission (single ZIP with code + README and an optional short writeup) to the Drive folder within 96 hours of first access, or by 2026-08-26 23:59 PT if you prefer to start now.
- If you need more time for a legitimate scheduling conflict, reply to this thread and we’ll review an extension (we try to avoid automatic extensions).
- Review process: we’ll run a staged review — a focused code pass, then a short system-design readout. Expect reviewer feedback within 48 hours of submission.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/TAKEHOME_2026_hs_881
Attachments: redwood_takehome_spec_v2.pdf (instructions + dataset stub)

Deliverables checklist (please include in your ZIP):
- runnable code with brief setup steps
- README with design choices and trade-offs
- optional short recording (<=5 min) explaining your approach

If that’s all good I’ll mark you as "prompt delivered" in our tracker and schedule reviewers. Confirm when you’ve received the spec and whether you’ll start now or want a fixed window.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring
Redwood Inference
